resources.string: Show recent photos on your computer
Your computer shows your newest camera photos and screenshots while it is connected, and you save the ones you want there.
Only the photos you picked. Your computer sees those alone.
Not allowed yet. Your computer shows no photos until you allow it.
link2linux reads your camera photos and screenshots to show them on your computer. Android asks next; you can allow all photos or only the ones you pick.

Your 200 newest camera photos and screenshots: their names, sizes and dates, small previews, and the photos you open or save there. Images from other apps and videos are left out. The photos stay on this phone; your computer keeps what it fetched in memory only, until you save a photo.
